authorityNote: This file is machine-readable governance CONFIG. It is NOT a governance authority and it outranks nothing. Authority order remains: GOVERNANCE_REWRITE_2026_06_10/LETBUYY_CONSTITUTION.md (supreme) > AGENTS.md > nested AGENTS.md > LETBUYY_CANONICAL_SYSTEMS.md. Where this file and any of those disagree, those win and the disagreement is a defect in this file. Classifications recorded here that the governance chain has not ratified are marked HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED and must not be read as a decision.
recordedBy: Wave 0 Web V1 scope-freeze agent (evidence run, not an ARB act)
purpose: Freeze the Web V1 capability perimeter as data so that a NEW activation of an excluded or forbidden capability fails the governance gate. This file does not remove, disable, or gate any capability that exists today.
honestyContract: knownActivationsBaseline is NOT a green field. It is an explicit, itemised list of excluded/forbidden capabilities that are ALREADY ACTIVE in the repository at baselineSha.
The validator is a RATCHET: the baseline may shrink, it may never grow without a human edit to this file.
No entry in this file asserts that an already-active capability is permitted. It asserts only that its activation predates the freeze and was recorded honestly.
Nothing in this file authorises a deferral that the governance chain has not made. See invariants.mustBeHumanDecisionRequired.

classifications.WEB_V1_REQUIRED: In scope for Web V1. Not perimeter-enforced by this validator (this validator guards the exclusion side only).
classifications.WEB_V1_DEFERRED: Excluded from Web V1 scope. Perimeter-enforced: no NEW activation signal may appear.
classifications.FORBIDDEN_FROZEN: Forbidden or frozen by the governance chain. Perimeter-enforced: no NEW activation signal may appear.
classifications.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: The governance chain has NOT ratified a classification, or the runtime is undocumented. Existence is recorded; NEW wiring into Web V1 deploy configuration is perimeter-enforced. MUST NOT be read as deferred, and MUST NOT be read as in scope.

enforcementModes.ratchet: Probes evaluated on every run; active-and-unbaselined = hard failure.

enforcementModes.none: Recorded for perimeter completeness only. No probe.

Deferral is achieved only by a runtime 503 when the secret is unset — an environment condition, not a code perimeter.
